# Sums the `amount` of each entry, grouped by `category`.
#
#   totals_by_category([{ category: "food", amount: 12 },
#                        { category: "rent", amount: 900 },
#                        { category: "food", amount: 8 }])
#   # => { "food" => 20, "rent" => 900 }
def totals_by_category(entries)
  entries.each_with_object(Hash.new(0)) do |entry, totals|
    totals[entry[:category]] += entry[:amount]
  end
end

if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
  p totals_by_category([
    { category: "food", amount: 12 },
    { category: "rent", amount: 900 },
    { category: "food", amount: 8 }
  ])
end
